edit.description: `commitsPast` asks git for the paths a merge's own tree differs from every parent on, and its doc names that reading
the merge arms, beside the frontier-union cases

summary: `commitsPast` takes git's default merge listing, which is empty, so a path a merge changed in neither parent is in no frontier and arms no rotation

per.section: The frontier is decidable; the neighborhood is judged

acceptance: a merge commit whose tree differs from every parent reports those paths, so the frontier, the liveness scan and the retired-claim narrowing each name a module a merge resolution changed; a merge that resolved nothing still reports none
tests: the frontier lists a path a merge commit changed in neither parent
pins: a merge commit that resolved nothing adds no path to the frontier
notes: Measured over this repo's own 7 merges: `commitsPast` (`harness/gitRange.ts:139`) gets 0 paths for every one, while 92c9cdd1 changed `src/Dispatcher.ts`, `src/PendingSchema.ts`, `src/Phase.ts`, `src/cli.ts` in neither parent and 707663bc changed `src/Dispatcher.ts` — all `src/**`. `--cc` reports exactly those 7 and 3, parses through the existing `-z` reader unchanged, and costs a resolved-nothing merge nothing. `diffOf`'s `git show` already narrows a merge to them.
